## Description

A weekly rota for each location: who works which shift. Doctors keep their schedule templates (P1-011); the rota shows them read-only beside other staff.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A shift cannot overlap another shift of the same person.
- [ ] **AC2.** The rota prints for the staff room without phone numbers.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
